topics.title: Birthday Show Improv
topics.summary: During a radio show, the host and his guests – including Christine from an acting class – engage in chaotic conversation about relationships, drunken behavior, and accusations of infidelity. The segment devolves into bizarre improvisational scenes involving multiple callers, culminating with Cope’s girlfriend attempting to seduce the listeners.

topics.title: Birthday Improvisation Chaos
topics.summary: During a live radio show celebrating Howard Stern’s birthday, hosts engage in rapid-fire improvisational scenes with guests including Terry Murray from Hawaii and Andy Murray (Bill Murray’s brother). The segment features tangents about movie criticism, personal relationships, and bizarre anecdotes culminating in revelations about Jessica's comments during an intimate moment.

topics.title: Donald Trump Calls In To Birthday Show
topics.summary: During a radio segment, host Howard Stern takes calls including one from Donald Trump who discusses his time at the Sunset Marquis Hotel and offers an unsolicited birthday greeting. The conversation quickly devolves into playful insults and boasts about wealth and influence, culminating in Trump demanding to be ‘eaten’.

topics.title: Birthday Show Protest and Celebrity Guests
topics.summary: During Howard Stern’s birthday show, protests erupted involving the Guardian Angels and several individuals concerned about his comments regarding Libyans. The hosts engaged in conversation with protesters and a celebrity guest, while also dealing with interruptions from other guests including Lisa Sleeewood and her ‘guardian angels,’ leading to a chaotic exchange of words.

topics.title: Stern Birthday Chaos & Arab Protests
topics.summary: During Howard Stern’s chaotic birthday broadcast, callers engaged in heated debates about terrorism and immigration, featuring personal attacks and accusations of racism. Richard Simmons joined the show with plans for an ice skating event involving handicapped children, further escalating the volatile conversation before abruptly ending.

topics.title: Stern’s Birthday Party at the Lone Star Roadhouse
topics.summary: Howard Stern hosts his 35th birthday party with guests including Leslie West and Dee Snyder, featuring greetings from Dick Hungate (program director in Richmond) and a phone interview discussing past career successes. Promotional segments highlight 94WYSP’s CD upgrade service and a contest to win a free CD, while Howard boasts about surpassing his former boss, Dick, with an extended conversation regarding their respective stations.
